November 2, 2026


This week, 20 Indigenous youth from communities across northern and southern Saskatchewan had the chance to explore the uranium and nuclear energy sector, including a fly-in visit to the Cigar Lake mine and a tour of Cameco's Corporate Office in Saskatoon. Along the way, they connected with employees, learned about student opportunities and career pathways and experienced mine site life firsthand. Thanks to our partners at CIC for helping create this unique opportunity to see where their future could lead.[#IndigenousYouth](https://facebook.com/hashtag/IndigenousYouth) #Saskatchewan[#FutureOpportunities](https://facebook.com/hashtag/FutureOpportunities)
